dedupe_keys.name: fpa fod attributes us wildfire occurrence records with physical social and infrastructure attributes

description: FPA FOD-Attributes augments the sixth version of the US Fire Program Analysis Fire Occurrence Database, which records the location, jurisdiction, discovery time, cause and final size of more than 2.2 million wildfires in the conterminous United States from 1992 to 2020, with nearly 270 attributes matched to the date and place of each ignition. Added attributes cover weather, climate, topography and infrastructure such as roads and fire stations, land cover and vegetation greenness, population density, social vulnerability, GDP and the national and regional preparedness level. Version 1.0 was published on 26 September 2023 by Pourmohamad, Abatzoglou, Short and colleagues from Boise State University, UC Merced and the USDA Forest Service Rocky Mountain Research Station. The CSV files, about 10 GB, are available free on Zenodo under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: attributes are sampled at ignition points, not over the burned area. It supports statistical and machine-learning models of ignition risk near infrastructure; a related record is the US wildfire burn zone disasters dataset.
